step1.title: Tell us about your trip
step1.body: Dates, where you start and end, and how many of you are travelling.

step2.title: Drivers send you offers
step2.body: Each offer has a fixed price and vehicle. We email you when one arrives.

step3.title: Chat, compare and book
step3.body: Ask questions, compare prices, and book the one you like in Messages.

quoteCard.title: Get quotes from drivers
quoteCard.body: Post your trip once and let vetted drivers come to you with offers. It is free, with no booking fee.

slot.body: Drivers reply with offers. We email you when one arrives, and you can compare and book them in Messages.

cancel.title: Cancel booking
notice: Free to cancel up to 2 days before start date.
50% of total cost to be paid to driver if cancelling within 2 days of start date.
100% of completed days and 50% of uncompleted days to be paid to driver if cancelling after start date.
